hero.title: Worship service management
hero.subtitle: Complete system to manage Adventist worship services: hymnal, liturgy, Bible, timer and projection in a single free web platform.

features.title: Everything in one place
features.description: Bringing together all the tools you need to coordinate the service, no paper, no scattered apps.

hymnal.title: Complete Hymnal
hymnal.description: Quick access to all hymns with search by number or title

bible.title: Integrated Bible
bible.description: Bible texts ready for reading and projection during the service

liturgy.title: Service Liturgy
liturgy.description: Complete program structure with order of items and participants

timer.title: Timer and Clock
timer.description: Time control for sermons, announcements and each part of the service

projection.title: Lyrics Projection
projection.description: Display hymn lyrics and texts on screen for the congregation

offline.title: Offline Mode
offline.description: Work without internet with local cache of hymns and Bible

how.title: How it works
how.description: Three steps to manage a complete service, from start to finish.

1.title: Build the liturgy
1.desc: Select hymns, Bible texts and the order of the service

2.title: Start the timer
2.desc: Control the time of each item in the program

3.title: Project on screen
3.desc: Display hymns and texts for the congregation in real time

platforms.title: Desktop, Web and Mobile
platforms.description: PIANO LouvorJA runs anywhere. Native desktop app (Linux, macOS and Windows), web version in the browser for quick access, and mobile apps for Android and iOS coming soon.

desktop.name: Desktop
desktop.description: Native app with all features: multi-screen projection, integrated media and full offline mode.

web.name: Web
web.description: Access from any PC without installation. Works as a complete fallback when the desktop app is not available.

mobile.name: Mobile
mobile.description: Control the service in the palm of your hand. Manage liturgy, project slides and track the schedule from your phone.

about.title: Technology in service of worship
about.text1: {name} was born from the need to have a simple and complete tool to manage Adventist worship services. Bringing together Bible, liturgy, hymnal, timer and projection in a single web platform, we make the work of those who coordinate services easier and reduce reliance on paper and fragmented tools.
about.text2: Developed with modern technology, the system runs directly in the browser with no installation required. Access from any device, anywhere.

cta.title: Ready to modernize your services?
cta.subtitle: Start right now. No sign-up, no installation, no cost. Access the platform and see how simple it is.
